# Acquiring nonlinear coordinates and the experiments for learning the next coordinate

24 October 2026. Internally derived theorem candidate. This is a complete written argument in the stated finite oracle model, with finite executable checks; independent external correctness and historical priority remain unknown.

The independent first question/construction is preserved verbatim in `FIRST_CONSTRUCTION.md`. The present argument incorporates the exact feasible-core cardinality and finite-grid corrections found independently by root and the bounded Luna checks. Four existing supports were used; none supplied the initial mechanism. No work from the fresh physical/material arm was read.

## 1. Contract and result

Write V=F₂ⁿ. An unknown bijection Q:V→V determines the oracle

    C(x,y) = 1{Q(x) <lex Q(y)}.

Q₁ is the most significant output bit. Each actual Qᵢ has Boolean algebraic degree at most two. The learner is supplied n and this quadratic-permutation promise, and receives exact chosen-pair comparisons. It does not receive Q, rank labels, output bit labels, a hidden basis, target code, significance flag, a fibre sampler or the rank/core size below. Raw input vectors and exact XOR/finite-field operations are available and charged. Equal submitted inputs are locally recognizable.

For a quadratic f define its polar form

    B_f(x,v)=f(x+v)+f(x)+f(v)+f(0).

This is an alternating bilinear form. For Fₜ=(Q₁,…,Qₜ), let

    Lₜ = intersection_(i≤t) rad B_Qᵢ,
    rₜ = n−dim Lₜ,              b(Q)=rₙ.

L₀=V, r₀=0. The computed rₜ are nondecreasing and bounded by b(Q); b(Q) is an **a posteriori complexity parameter**. It need not be supplied or cheaply certified from the unknown comparator.

**Theorem 1 (comparison-only quadratic acquisition).** For 0<δ<1, a randomized learner returns the exact Q₁,…,Qₙ on every input with probability at least 1−δ.     R=the least odd integer at least 8 ln(n Dₙ/δ).

A fresh-median implementation uses at most

    32,200 n Dₙ R

# Learning opportunity checkpoint

24 October 2026. Positive restricted acquisition construction; civilisation-level capability, independent external correctness and historical novelty are **not established**.

The owned question is whether opaque order comparisons can produce an exact reusable nonlinear representation **and the conditional experiments needed to acquire its later coordinates**, without receiving hidden labels, coordinates or samplers. The initial substantive construction was saved in `FIRST_CONSTRUCTION.md` before exposing it to the four existing Luna supports or reading the fresh physical/material arm.

`PROOF.md` gives the complete finite-oracle argument. The learner receives n, exact chosen-input comparisons and the promise that the hidden rank is a quadratic Boolean permutation. It learns leading coordinate polynomials. Their acquired common polar radical gives exact uniform prefix preparation. Conditional medians provide averaged next-bit labels; seven-vertex quadratic correction plus interpolation acquires the next polynomial. No hidden core rank is supplied. The fresh-median version has O(n³ log(n/δ)) comparisons. With high probability, correctness and 2^b(Q) poly(n,log(1/δ)) classical cost hold jointly; an erroneous acquired prefix can instead incur the all-branch 2^n cap. No unconditional FPT expectation is claimed.

`QUOTIENT_PREPARATION_SUPPLEMENT.md` strengthens the preparation: reject on the acquired quotient equations, with exact success probability 2^(-sₜ), sₜ=t−rank Aₜ. It proves a strict-prefix inverse bypass, finite rejection/coupon timeouts, and a joint confidence/runtime bound in κ=max_(t<n)sₜ. This mathematical supplement is **not the algorithm measured by the core-table executable**. The large-final-polar-rank shear example has κ=0; it is also in the older triangular incumbent's class, so this is a cost improvement over our first core-table construction, not a new advantage over that incumbent.

## Actual computation

`acquire_quadratic_order.py` receives only the comparator and declared class interface. Teacher truth enters after acquisition to validate all ranks, all inverse targets and every prefix fibre. The final acquired affine/core compiler also runs without the oracle. PRNG fixtures are implementation checks, not ideal-entropy certification.
